newsitem.title: UK: West children oppose "House of Horror" film.
newsitem.headline: West children oppose "House of Horror" film.

text.p: The children of serial killers Fred and Rosemary West have angrily opposed any plans to make a film about their notorious parents.
"Why should any of us be given money because of something terrible our parents did?" Stephen West told the Observer newspaper.
On Thursday, a British entertainments company shelved plans to make a controversial film about the Wests.

The announcement by the Portman Entertainment Group came as the British government promised an urgent review of the law after one of its legal officials aroused a storm of protest by selling the company an option to the film rights.

Stephen West said: "We don't want any of it. We don't want the money and we don't want the film. The Official Solicitor says he has to do everything he can to benefit the West children but the West children don't want that kind of benefit."
Fred West was found hanged two years ago in a prison cell where he was awaiting multiple charges of murder.

Many of his victims' bodies were found buried in the garden and cellar of his home at 25 Cromwell Street in Gloucester, western England -- a building so notorious that officials not only knocked it down but ground its bricks into dust.
Rosemary is now serving 10 life sentences for murdering girls and young women.
